name: Agentic Payments
tagline: Agents that transact, buy, sell, provision services and manage budgets - with every transfer of funds held for human stewards

charter.focus: agents interacting with financial infrastructure autonomously, under the PBC's reserved-for-humans list
charter.mission: Ensure advanced AI is governed as a public good, with benefits shared widely and deployed toward humanity's most urgent challenges.

zones.name: Transaction Desk
zones.purpose: Where agents transact, buy and sell - drafted and reconciled here, never settled by an agent

zones.name: Service Provisioning Counter
zones.purpose: Provisioning services an agent may order within a steward-set budget

zones.name: Budget Office
zones.purpose: Managing budgets: proposals, ledgers and variance drafted for the stewards

zones.name: Financial Infrastructure Gateway
zones.purpose: Interacting with financial infrastructure in rehearsal: reads, quotes and dry runs
zones.source: worlds/sources/founder-tracks-2026-09-28.md, Agentic Payments: 'interact with financial infrastructure autonomously'

agents.name: Buyer Agent
agents.role: Drafts purchases against a steward-set budget and hands the settlement to the stewards

agents.name: Seller Agent
agents.role: Drafts sale offers and reconciles what was sold; never moves the proceeds

agents.name: Provisioning Agent
agents.role: Orders services within budget and records what was provisioned

agents.name: Budget Agent
agents.role: Manages budget drafts, ledgers and variance reports for steward review

agents.name: Rail Agent
agents.role: Reads balances, fetches quotes and dry-runs transactions against financial infrastructure

gaps: No rails, currencies, limits, wallets or counterparties are named; nothing in this world moves money
treasury.transfer is reserved for human stewards, so 'autonomously' here means drafting and reconciling, not settling
No source names a person, partner or budget figure
